accepted.sentence: Chopped pieces add a bright sweet-and-tart contrast to savory rice dishes, curries, and stir-fries.
Diced flesh mixed with peppers, onion, and herbs makes a fruit salsa for grilled foods or tacos.
Pureed flesh can flavor cake batter while adding moisture to baked desserts.
Dried rings provide a chewy, shelf-stable snack that is easy to pack for travel.
Frozen chunks blend smoothly into drinks, contributing both fruit flavor and a thick texture.
Cooking the fruit with sugar produces a preserve that can be spread on toast or served with cheese.
Its sweet acidity gives sweet-and-sour sauces a fruity counterpoint to savory ingredients.
Slices can be arranged over glazed ham, where they contribute flavor and an attractive edible topping.
